# Alibaba Cloud

Alibaba Cloud is a public company listed under ticker BABA. The company operates Qwen Studio, a platform that the company describes as offering "comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts."

The company's primary AI product tracked here is Qwen, also known as Tongyi Qianwen, a Chinese foundation model available at qwen.ai. Users should note that cross-border data review is advised for this product.
